contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
OFMVRAVI (The M and V are ligated as is the R and A) , La Graufesenque, South Gaulish, Potter Murran

A collection of five Roman Samian ware bases with potter's stamps, AD.50-250. The fragments are from the bases of a variety of vessels, Fragment 1 is likely a Drag.27 cup, as is fragment 5. The remaining three fragments all have base angles that are quite flat and small foot rigs suggesting small plates or dishes. Fragment 1.
